en: Sepia-toned historic street view showing a broad, unpaved road lined with multi‑story townhouses and commercial buildings. Several people stand and walk along the sidewalks. On the left is a long building with a large painted sign. In the distance a tall industrial-looking chimney or tower rises above the rooftops. Printed caption text appears at the top, and a business sign is visible on the left facade.
